tldr: Chiron transiting the 2nd house: a long healing chapter around money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Chiron moving through the 2nd house can reopen old material around money, resources, values, and self-worth. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound lives in self-worth and resources; you may chase or distrust money and struggle to feel you deserve.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through money, resources, values, and self-worth. You help others build security and value themselves accurately.
shadow: Equating your worth with what you have, in either direction.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 2nd house deliberately. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
